item.title: We've watched political violence grow overseas. Now it's arrived on our shores
item.description: Helen Haines has fought for integrity in politics. She deserved to be treated with respect and integrity too. Instead, she is apparently Australia's first victim of a targeted attack on a politician on this scale. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: Helen Haines remains critical as police investigation continues after 'attack'
item.description: Anthony Albanese says counter-terrorism police are investigating and a man has been arrested after Indi MP Helen Haines was "attacked" near her electorate office in Victoria's north-east. Follow the latest in our live blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Melissa Parke: «El rearme nuclear para Europa significa que será la primera en ser destruida»
item.description: Melissa Parke (Australia, 1966) detiene sus palabras para masticar una respuesta. Piensa, durante esa breve tregua, en cómo sería el día después del fin del mundo y relata, con un detenimiento mayor al del resto de la entrevista, como eligiendo las palabras adecuadas, un planeta en el que todo podría haberse acabado. «Nikita Khruschov (líder comunista de la Unión Soviética) dijo que los vivos envidiarán a los muertos . Y es verdad», reconoce. Después narra una «lenta muerte por radiación que es básicamente como el ébola: estás sangrando por dentro, tus órganos se desintegran». Incluso si… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: While Australia scrambled for fuel, millions of litres were being exported offshore
item.description: More than 60 megalitres of Australian-made biofuel products were being sold offshore at the same time as the nation's petrol and diesel pumps ran dry.
